description: SAPOS® Geodätischer Postprocessing Positionierungs-Service - GPPS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The Geodetic Postprocessing Positioning Service (GPPS) is one of three service areas of the Satellite Positioning Service (SAPOS®) of the German national survey. Registered users can purchase the correction and observation data from the Bavarian SAPOS® reference stations or have an online calculation of official ETRS89 positions from rover observations. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "SAPOS® Geodetic Postprocessing Positioning Service — GPPS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GPPS, AdVMIS, Satellitenpositionierung, Satellitenmessung, Positionsverbesserung, Positionsgenauigkeit. The listing shows 2025-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
